name: Fixed-history token-group contribution diagnostic
hypothesis: The current regional selector ranks useful memory evidence: removing rejected-enriched groups harms present Dice less than matched retained-enriched and random groups.
scope: Exploratory PolypGen, 21 sequences excluding seq1/seq7. Group contribution conditional on native history and this intervention. Not individual token attribution, anatomical content, oracle method efficacy, patient-independent confirmation or full propagation.

model.device: CPU FP32; native bfloat16 stored memory retained
model.frozen: All original parameters; native frame selection, encoder, decoder, object-presence decision, pointers, position encodings and memory writes.
model.prompt: Existing first-labeled-frame mask prompt; no later GT enters selection or prediction.
model.native_memory: Prompt plus up to six recent processed manifest frames. Current frame supplies queries, not a stored memory frame. Chronology refers to sampled manifest frames, not guaranteed consecutive source-video frames.
model.intervention: Only spatial K/V retrieval inside all four memory cross-attention layers. Read-time gathering leaves the stored memory intact. Prompt and latest memory frame stay full; pointer tail stays exact. Original cell RoPE coordinates are gathered, never reassigned.

efficient_sam2.reuse: Unchanged author Attention.forward for chunked first-recollection latest-frame importance; unchanged get_topk_mask; existing author gather assignments and apply_rotary_enc_prune via modeling/sparse_memory.py.
efficient_sam2.importance: For each layer, softmax current-query dot products over the latest unpruned frame only, average over query positions/heads. Cache a mask for that frame's later reads, as in the author's top-k retrieval path.

lean_sam2.download_check: Fresh official clone at external/Lean-SAM2-token-selection confirmed the same revision as the existing checkout. Reuse the existing pinned checkout, preserving past runs.
lean_sam2.reuse: Unchanged prompt-mask-to-token, diverse-anchor selection, max-cosine similarity, score preparation and multiplicative fusion methods from SAM2Base.
lean_sam2.isolation: Memory selection components only. No temporal condensation, insurance bank, encoder routing or confidence-based branches. This adaptation is not a reproduction of the full published method.

prior_audit: protocols/PRIOR_EXPERIMENTS.md: whole-region exclusions already exist. This diagnostic instead compares selector-disposition enrichment at modest matched removal and adds split-group interactions. Existing pinned repositories are reused; no new predictive method is attributed to a paper.
selector: Run170 regional formula and 25% per-frame retention masks, recomputed causally on untouched NATIVE reads. Native trajectory retains ALL tokens. First-recollection usage is computed from the latest frame as in the pinned Efficient-SAM2 method. Prompt foreground/context anchors and soft own-stored-mask occupancy match Run170. No GT enters the selector.

groups.split: A/B are the first/last 8 rejected-enriched blocks. AB is their exact union.
groups.ranking: Rank disjoint 4x4 blocks by count of selector-retained cells; ties use context-seeded permutation. Lowest 16 are rejected-enriched; highest 16 retained-enriched. Record actual retained fraction; do not call these pure rejected/retained tokens.
groups.controls: Uniform sample of 16 blocks from the same grid. Exact removed count, block shape, memory-frame age and four-layer schedule; global arrangement/contiguity is not matched. One fixed random seed 20261107; no best-seed selection. Random groups may overlap other arms.
groups.protected: Prompt frame, latest frame and pointer tail remain exact. Older native spatial frames only. Native cell RoPE and temporal slots remain unchanged. All four memory layers are intervened jointly; no individual-layer causal claim.

sampling.rule: Before inference, find first labeled prompt. Candidate targets start prompt+3, ensuring an older eligible nonprompt memory. Within each sequence, uniformly select up to 4 GT-present and up to 2 GT-empty candidates using rounded linspace over chronological stratum indices. Save exact target list and input hashes in setup.json before any inference. No outcome-dependent target selection.
sampling.limits: GT-stratified diagnostic target sample, not a full-cohort framewise efficacy estimate. Missing GT-empty frames are explicitly reported. Same manifest processed frames and original source indices are saved; do not equate manifest steps with source-video frames.

stages.engineering: First seq2/seq3: independent uninstrumented native trajectories vs read-only collector, all full-resolution logits bit-identical. Native replay masks/pointers/object scores and full-resolution hashes exact on EVERY postprompt frame. Read-only hooks, attention mass normalized, actual key counts, original-cell position reuse, all four layers, pointer-tail unchanged, replay sample/bank/cache and original parameters unchanged. Repeat first sampled random intervention exactly. Fail closed on any mismatch.
stages.cohort: After engineering passes, run remaining 19 sequences sequentially regardless of gate scientific effects. Use gate seq2/seq3 sampled results directly. Native trajectories with read-only collector and paired diagnostic replays at frozen targets; no treatment writeback or memory encoding. Native parity at every sampled target. No full-propagation efficacy launch.

metrics.primary: Dice averaged over sampled present targets within each sequence, then equally across eligible sequences.
metrics.utility: U(G)=Dice_native-Dice_without_G. Positive means the removal hurts this prediction; negative means removal helps. Zero is unresolved/redundant at this resolution, not proof of dispensability. Do not identify individual causal vectors from a group effect.
metrics.statistics: Paired sequence bootstrap 10000 resamples seed 20261107; paired Wilcoxon with Holm across both primary contrasts. Report every sequence and wins/losses. No frame-level significance tests.
secondary: Boundary F via existing DAVIS implementation
GT-empty false alarm count/rate with per-sequence and pooled denominators
removed counts, selector enrichment, first-read attention mass, soft foreground occupancy and memory-vector norm
metrics.interaction: U(AB)-U(A)-U(B)=Dice_A+Dice_B-Dice_AB-Dice_native. Positive means joint removal hurts more than additive. This is descriptive nonadditivity and includes attention normalization effects, not unique representation redundancy.

decisions.discrimination_signal: On all 21 sequences, both primary sequence-bootstrap lower bounds >0 and majority sequence wins. This supports exploratory ranking discrimination only. Report Holm p-values; do not claim deployment benefit.
decisions.if_negative: Stop selector refinement; report effect distributions and limitations. No outcome-driven budget, weights or extra seeds.
decisions.if_positive: A bounded single-pulse temporal diagnostic may be proposed. Freeze targets independently of observed treatment gains and commit a separate protocol before launching; no automatic efficacy run. An oracle diagnostic never establishes a deployable policy.

provenance.freeze: Commit protocol, integration, runner and tests before inference; archive and hash all imported scientific sources and input files. Never overwrite prior runs.
provenance.storage: All experiment outputs, temporary staged frame links and runtime logs go under mounted Google Drive outputs/experiment/171_token_contribution_v1. Mount writes are not independent proof of cloud sync. No model checkpoint training or local result copy.
provenance.runtime_tracking: run_status.json, setup.json, per-sequence receipts and masks/frames.jsonl, engineering_pass.json, partial_results.json, analysis.md, results.json, completion.json or failure.json. Network logging must not stop science.

verification_amendments.reason: Persist and compare independent native reference hashes for low-resolution masks, object pointers and object-score logits as well as full-resolution logits. Initial attempt interrupted during seq3 engineering; no cohort launch or scientific changes.
